value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks wet and warm. Showers with a risk of thunderstorms through the morning and afternoon, around 10 to 20 mm of rain, and a high of 24°C. Wind southwest at 20 km/h, gusting to 40 near noon. Tuesday night stays cloudy with showers and drops to about 12°C. That's the Environment Canada forecast from this morning.
